02 Output settings

Uses your heading above, or each file's name if left blank. All reconstructed pages use true A4 (210 × 297 mm) with 14 pt body text.

Automatic output decision
  • Interactive quiz: Clean A4 question pages with clickable options opening one answer & explanation page.
  • Partial interactive quiz: Reliable MCQs + coverage warning + conversion report + A4 fallback.
  • A4 formatted copy — not interactive: Preserves source content when MCQs are unavailable.
  • Original download: Unchanged original remains downloadable if formatting fails.

03 Combine quiz PDFs

Select two or more quiz PDFs, arrange their order below, and combine them. Continuous renumbering is used when quiz metadata is available; otherwise a page-preserving merge is offered.

Download combined PDF
True A4 & 14 pt layout

Reconstructed text uses 14 pt on A4 pages with continuation pages as needed. Scanned pages and complex layouts preserve their original visual content proportionally without claiming changed font sizes.

Standard PDF links

Every option links to the same answer & explanation page using standard PDF GoTo links (no JavaScript). Correct answers are green; incorrect headings are light red; missing keys say “No answer for this question.”

Honest count & fallback reporting

Verified counts, estimated counts, unresolved indices, and partial coverage are reported separately. Every file keeps a manual download button, with no automatic downloads.

Supported formats & conversion details

Supports PDF (text, BMJ OnExamination, MyPastest, paired screenshot banks, and scanned pages via local English OCR), DOCX (including automatic numbering), PPTX, XLSX/XLS/CSV/TSV, TXT/MD/HTML/JSON, and raster images (PNG, JPG, WebP, BMP, GIF). Already-interactive PDFs generated by PDF Interactive Studio retain their existing pages and links without forced legacy reconstruction. Password-protected or corrupt PDFs cannot be repaired automatically and remain downloadable as unchanged originals.
